reading_rule: Structural enumeration of retrieved bytes. A row states what candidate values the artifact exposes per component, not which one produced any reported number. Evaluator-like paths are structural inventory only; role assignment occurs in outcome-specific adjudication, and result products are never evaluator code. Recomputation outputs were not read: protocol §3 forbids selecting a candidate because its value matches the paper, which makes them inadmissible evidence.
